text: Even an enemy helped him: an engineer sent to ruin Qin with a giant construction project dug a canal that ended up feeding its army.
spoken: Even an enemy helped him. [chuckle] An engineer sent to ruin Chin with a giant construction project dug a canal that ended up feeding its army.
